title: About page
description: Who the business is: what it does, the credentials it holds, one customer's words about working with it, the names it works with, and its figures from Site Data.

copy_guidance.Eyebrow: The business's name or trade, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Heading: Who the business is and what it does, in a line.
copy_guidance.Body: One line on who runs it or how it works. The year it started is a claim: use Site Data's year founded, and leave it out when that is empty.

copy_guidance.Credential 1: A licence, insurance or membership, from Site Data's credentials list or as the site owner gave it.

copy_guidance.Heading: What the business does, in a few words.
copy_guidance.Intro: One line on the kind of work it takes on, or for whom.

copy_guidance.Heading: What one customer said about working with the business, in a few words. No count or score.
copy_guidance.Review 1 quote: A review the site owner gave you that speaks to the people or the way they work, in the customer's own words.

copy_guidance.Eyebrow: Whose logos these are, such as the suppliers, partners or memberships the site owner names. No count.

copy_guidance.Heading: What the figures say about the business, in a few words, such as At a glance. No figure in it.
copy_guidance.Body: One line that leads into the figures, with no figure or claim of its own.

copy_guidance.Heading: One short sentence that invites the visitor to get in touch.
copy_guidance.Body: How to reach the business, and what happens next.
